sources: Owner-approved twin cities gameplay, graphics and expansion roadmap, 14 November 2026
name: Ulenna

lines.text: The birds leave a path between the nests. We keep to the same path, and nobody has to move.
I count arrivals from the old stone shelf. It is a useful ruin when we leave most of it alone.
You have noticed the nesting rooms upriver. Here the tide makes the rooms; the same courtesy keeps them open.
